provenance.source_title: How Pawn Shops Actually Make Money

examples.psychological_goal: 让观众以为这只是旧货店，为随后的重定义蓄势
examples.expression_mechanism: 三个具体物象堆叠后接“车库甩卖却租了店面挂了霓虹灯”的荒诞对照
examples.example_text: store. It looks like somebody's dusty garage sale that somehow got a lease and a neon sign. And if that's all you see,
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用具体物象+荒诞对照开场，先建立错误直觉再打破它
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制典当行物象；新主题必须找到同样日常且可被翻转的场景

examples.psychological_goal: 把抽象利息转成“为自己的戒指付租金”的体感损失
examples.expression_mechanism: 逐月时间推演后接隐喻重命名（paid rent on their own ring）
examples.example_text: another month. They haven't paid down a single dollar of what they owe. They've just paid rent on their own ring. If
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在数字推演后用一句隐喻重命名损失，完成情绪落点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要照搬租金隐喻措辞；新案例需有真实的滚动成本结构

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众从旁观者翻转成局中的产品
examples.expression_mechanism: “The stuff on the shelves isn’t the product, you are”式视角翻转短句
examples.example_text: here's the detail that everyone misses about pawn shops. The stuff on the shelves isn't the product, you are. And
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“你才是产品”式短句把商业模式指向观众自身
examples.negative_instruction: 不要在缺乏真实机制时用此句式制造廉价震惊

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句话完成行业身份重定义
examples.expression_mechanism: 先否定招牌说法，再给极短判断句“is a bank. That’s it.”
examples.example_text: not what the sign on the building says it is. A pawn shop is a bank. That's it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习“不是招牌上写的，而是 X”的极短重定义节奏
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制“bank”结论；重定义必须由后文机制支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用干式类比让观众在理解机制时会心一笑
examples.expression_mechanism: 把放贷结构类比为“扣押你物品的发薪日贷款机构”
examples.example_text: to have display cases. Think of it like a payday lender that holds your stuff hostage. You You in something valuable,
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用略带反讽的生活化类比降低机制理解成本
examples.negative_instruction: 幽默只放在机制解释处；不得调侃借款人或受害者处境；源字幕此段有转写重复噪声（You You），只学习类比机制，不得模仿噪声

examples.psychological_goal: 用对称分支证明店方无输面
examples.expression_mechanism: “If you pay, great… If you don’t pay, great”双赢对仗
examples.example_text: pay, great. They made money on the interest. If you don't pay, great. They keep your stuff and sell it for more
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用对仗分支展示结构的必然盈利，而非单点指控
examples.negative_instruction: 不要把对仗用在并非双赢的结构上；需先有真实双向证据

examples.psychological_goal: 把订阅请求绑在“数字将更疯狂”的内容升级承诺上
examples.expression_mechanism: 身份指认（喜欢弄清钱怎么赚的人）+下段预告+CTA 三合一
examples.example_text: of person who likes knowing how the money actually works, hit subscribe because this is where the numbers get wild. So, the system sounds clean.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让中段 CTA 承担换挡功能，而不是空喊关注
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制频道 CTA 措辞；CTA 必须与下一段真实升级一致

examples.psychological_goal: 用年化换算击碎“月费很小”的话术安全感
examples.example_text: 15% per month, which is legal in a bunch of states, that's 180% APR. And 25% per month, that 300% number in Georgia,
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把话术口径连续换算成真实成本口径
examples.negative_instruction: 不要编造换算；所有利率必须有可核验来源与地域限定

examples.psychological_goal: 用上市公司财报证明利息才是主业
examples.expression_mechanism: 零售额对照利息额，再补“同比增 16%”的增长信号
examples.example_text: million. That's a lot, but pawn loan fees, the interest income, brought in another $505 million, and that line grew 16% year-over-year. A half billion
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用公开财报的口径对照替代主观指控
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制金额；财报数字必须按原披露口径引用

examples.psychological_goal: 让“已被熔毁”的时间差成为全片最痛的损失画面
examples.expression_mechanism: 通知时间线+“不只是熔化金币，是熔化收藏品”的递进否定
examples.example_text: 5th. And by then, the shop had already melted them down. Not just melted the gold ones, melted the collectible coins,
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用时间差+递进否定呈现不可逆损失
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制案件细节；损失画面必须来自可核验事实

examples.psychological_goal: 把一年滚动后的总额与仍在柜台后的戒指并置，制造窒息感
examples.expression_mechanism: 时间总额对照+具体物件仍在原处
examples.example_text: After a year, you've paid 720, more than double the original loan, and your grandmother's ring is still sitting
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“付出总额 vs 物件位置”的并置呈现陷阱重量
examples.negative_instruction: 不要把假设性示例写成真实个案；源文用 say 标记了假设口径，迁移时保留

examples.psychological_goal: 把行业引以为傲的赎回率重读为陷阱有效的证据
examples.expression_mechanism: 先引行业口径，再用“That’s proof the trap works”短句翻转
examples.example_text: that's not customer satisfaction. That's proof the trap works. 85% of customers
examples.usage_instruction: 学习对同一指标做立场翻转式重读
examples.negative_instruction: 重读必须有前文机制支撑，不得为翻转而翻转

examples.psychological_goal: 用“此前一切合法，但有些店不止于此”完成从民事到刑事的换挡
examples.expression_mechanism: 合法边界句+But 转折+时间地点落地
examples.example_text: far sits inside the law. But some shops don't stay there. In December 2024,
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用边界句划分叙事层级，让升级有法理依据
examples.negative_instruction: 不要空喊“更可怕的还在后面”；换挡必须立刻给证据

examples.psychological_goal: 把 1900 万美元赃物规模连到观众自己购物的商店
examples.expression_mechanism: 大额数字+“你本月可能就在这些店购物”的个人化
examples.example_text: about that number for a second. $19 million in sales, built entirely on merchandise that was stolen from stores you've probably shopped at this month.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把宏观犯罪数字压回观众的日常场景
examples.negative_instruction: 不要夸大关联；个人化必须由案件事实支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用对照隔离证明相关性精确落在店铺能变现的犯罪类别上
examples.expression_mechanism: 类别排除法+“Not a penny more, not a penny less”收束
examples.example_text: exactly the category of crime that pawn shops can monetize. Not a penny more, not a penny less. But the most striking
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用对照类别排除替代“相关不等于因果”的空泛声明
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制对照措辞；新研究需确有对照设计

examples.psychological_goal: 完成从“店铺位于犯罪下游”到“店铺改变犯罪数学”的因果重构
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定旧位置+改变数学+反馈回路命名+“看见就无法视而不见”
examples.example_text: changed the math that made crime worth committing. That's the feedback loop, and once you see it, you can't unsee it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在证据充分后给机制命名，完成认知闭环
examples.negative_instruction: 因果结论必须由对照与自然实验支撑，不得从个案跳跃

examples.psychological_goal: 用“熔炉在中间确保无人能证明”的机器意象收束整个回答
examples.expression_mechanism: 三重否定后接核心意象+门店数量回扣
examples.example_text: stolen goods on the other with a furnace in the middle that makes sure nobody can prove what came through the door. 3,855
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在结尾只回收最关键的机制意象，不复述全部细节
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制熔炉意象；新主题需有真实的“消失机制”

examples.psychological_goal: 用“你社区里大概率也有”的地域落点加下期预告完成互动
examples.expression_mechanism: 本地化评论邀请+“下期再拆一门生意”的系列承诺
examples.example_text: neighborhood. I'd bet there is. Hit subscribe if you want to see how the next business actually works under the hood.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把评论 CTA 与主题本地化绑定，订阅 CTA 与下期内容绑定
examples.negative_instruction: 不要套用话术；本地化邀请必须与主题真实相关
